tasks.short: Test mine air for toxic gases and recommend removal measures.

steps.what: Choose actual air-test locations, methods and applicable gas comparison criteria
inputs: actual mine ventilation conditions and test purpose
actual applicable test methods and gas criteria
outputs: checked air-test plan and applicable comparison criteria

steps.what: Test actual mine air and capture and verify gas readings and conditions
inputs: checked air-test plan and applicable comparison criteria
actual calibrated instruments and mine air
outputs: actual verified gas readings with time, location, units and test conditions

steps.what: Compare verified toxic-gas readings with actual applicable criteria and flag incompatible tests
inputs: actual verified gas readings with time, location, units and test conditions
checked air-test plan and applicable comparison criteria
outputs: traceable gas comparisons and explicit missing or incompatible cases

steps.what: Interpret actual gas findings and recommend suitable ventilation or other removal measures
inputs: traceable gas comparisons and explicit missing or incompatible cases
actual mine geometry and ventilation constraints
outputs: actual substantiated gas-removal recommendations and urgent concerns

steps.what: Write and check actual air-test findings and recommendations in the internal record
inputs: actual substantiated gas-removal recommendations and urgent concerns
actual verified gas readings with time, location, units and test conditions
outputs: checked saved actual mine-air test and recommendation record

tasks.design: Configure verified unit-compatible gas comparisons in {SPREADSHEET}; OTHER denotes the actual gas-test instrument application. Retain test planning, all real testing and capture, interpretation and ventilation recommendations, plus complete written findings; ordinary saving stays ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual gas-reading and limit comparisons can repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: Native checked formulas can compare already verified applicable readings.
tasks.still_hard: Representative sampling and suitable mine ventilation require actual engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognizes a misleading isolated reading that does not represent the actual hazard.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed compatible gas-limit comparisons can run deterministically while testing and ventilation judgement remain human.

assumptions: Provisional compare15 is actual manual comparison, not instrument/runtime saving. Engineer selects actual method/criteria/version in20 and measures/captures location, time, gas, value, units and conditions in40. Missing or incompatible readings require manual assessment; no free instrument feed or AI hazard detector.

All recommendation15 and written/check work10 remain. Existing comparisons receive zero credit. Immediate safety response is not delayed for software; this design changes comparison preparation only and does not send a safety instruction, issue an order or start ventilation equipment. Ordinary internal save remains fully retained.
unknowns: Which actual comparisons are not already performed by the instrument?
research_questions: Can missing test context reliably stop a misleading comparison?

incremental.description: Maintain gas criteria versions and unit/test-context exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes15 manual comparison points minus0.7 upkeep=14.3. Low: a nonstandard gas mixture needs manual contextual interpretation and most comparisons, leaving only4 unambiguous compatible reading-comparison points removable, minus0.7=3.3. Planning, actual testing/capture, recommendations and full records remain.

tasks.short: Implement and coordinate mine safety programs and protective or rescue equipment work.

steps.what: Design actual mine safety measures and protective, rescue and safety-device requirements
inputs: actual mine hazards and equipment requirements
actual applicable safety program context
outputs: chosen mine safety program and equipment requirements

steps.what: Prepare selected equipment inspection and maintenance checklists with current requirement references
inputs: chosen mine safety program and equipment requirements
actual current selected equipment checklist sections
outputs: checked actual equipment implementation and maintenance checklist

steps.what: Coordinate actual mine safety implementation and equipment responsibilities with responsible teams
inputs: checked actual equipment implementation and maintenance checklist
actual teams, equipment and operational constraints

steps.what: Implement and oversee actual protective and rescue equipment maintenance and safety-device activities
inputs: actual coordinated safety-program activities
actual protective/rescue equipment and safety devices
outputs: actual captured implementation and equipment-condition observations

steps.what: Write and check actual safety-program and equipment outcomes in the internal record
inputs: actual captured implementation and equipment-condition observations
outputs: checked saved actual safety-program implementation record

tasks.design: Configure selected current equipment-checklist sections in {DOCS} and the actual mine equipment-maintenance application, OTHER. Retain safety and equipment design, live coordination, actual implementation/maintenance oversight and fresh outcome writing; ordinary saving remains ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current checklist sections and equipment requirement references can be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native section reuse can reduce fixed checklist assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Actual protective capability and safe equipment condition need engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer identifies a rescue-equipment weakness that a completed checklist would miss.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current equipment-checklist sections can be reused while actual safety implementation stays human.

assumptions: Provisional checklist15 removes three repeated section/reference assembly points; twelve actual adaptation/check points remain. Equipment/program owners supply actual asset id, checklist revision and requirements; engineer chooses/checks applicability and prepares missing methods manually. Existing reuse receives zero credit.

Actual observations captured in35 precede fresh record10. No invented completed-maintenance feed or automatic equipment release. Ordinary save is fully retained without self-approval; actual live coordination is separate from the written checklist and post-event records.
unknowns: Which current equipment checklist sections are reusable?
research_questions: Does reuse preserve actual equipment type and maintenance revision?

incremental.description: Maintain equipment/checklist revisions and requirement applicability.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 fixed-checklist assembly points minus0.5 upkeep=2.5. Low: new rescue equipment requires a fresh procedure and checks, leaving only0.7 asset/reference-header point reusable, minus0.5=0.2. Safety design, coordination, real maintenance oversight and full records remain.

tasks.short: Devise land-reclamation and water or air pollution solutions for mine sites.

steps.what: Locate actual mine-site landform, soil, water and air evidence and current constraints
inputs: actual reclamation or pollution problem
actual site-owner surveys, test records and constraints

steps.what: Examine actual site conditions and capture relevant soil, drainage and pollution observations
inputs: checked current reclamation evidence packet
actual mine site and affected land/water/air conditions
outputs: actual captured site constraints and unresolved conditions

steps.what: Devise actual soil storage, land restoration and water or air pollution solutions
inputs: actual captured site constraints and unresolved conditions
checked current reclamation evidence packet
outputs: actual engineered solution alternatives and limitations

steps.what: Write and check actual reclamation or pollution solution recommendations and retain supporting evidence
inputs: actual engineered solution alternatives and limitations
outputs: checked saved actual mine-site solution recommendations

tasks.design: Configure current site-evidence links in {DOCS} and the actual mine geological/environmental records application, OTHER. Retain actual site examination, solution design and complete written recommendations; ordinary internal saving remains ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current soil, landform and pollution evidence can require repeated locating.
tasks.enabler_now: Native site-linked views reduce navigation without devising the engineering solution.
tasks.still_hard: Stable restoration and pollution control depend on actual site interactions.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer sees that a soil-storage proposal would create a new drainage problem.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: site-linked evidence views can reduce locating for mine reclamation investigation.

assumptions: Provisional source20 removes three locating points; seventeen actual evidence relevance/check points remain. Actual site/test owners supply record id/revision, location, period, method and units; engineer checks relevance and captures actual missing observations during30. No free prepared site model or AI contamination interpretation.

All solution design40 and real written recommendations10 remain. Existing linked views get zero credit. No implementation order, external report send or extra author approval of ordinary saving is assumed.
unknowns: Which current site evidence is already linked?
research_questions: Do evidence links preserve sampling period and actual spatial coverage?

incremental.description: Maintain current reclamation evidence and spatial/period links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 evidence-navigation points minus0.6 upkeep=2.4. Examination, actual solution design and full written recommendations remain.

tasks.enabler_now: Native profile-sheet reuse reduces selected drawing assembly.
